seo.description: Night Shift is a podcast about people who work while everyone else sleeps. A new episode every other Thursday.

props.title: Night Shift
props.text: Conversations with people who work while everyone else sleeps: bakers, nurses, lock keepers, a man who repaints the lines on runways.
props.alt: The Night Shift cover: sound bars in a dark circle

items.title: 42. The lock keeper of Caen Hill
items.text: Twenty-nine locks, one man, and the boats that arrive at 3am.

items.title: 41. Runway 27 Left
items.text: Painting white lines between the last landing and the first.

items.title: 40. Bread for 6am
items.text: A bakery where the day starts at 11 at night.

items.title: 39. The 2am vet
items.text: What gets brought in when nobody else is open.

items.title: 38. Signal box
items.text: One of the last hand-worked boxes on the network.

props.title: Who makes it
props.text: Recorded and edited by Callum Reid, who worked nights in a hospital laundry for six years and never got his sleep back.

props.title: Know when an episode is out
props.text: One short email, every other Thursday morning.
Night Shift is made in Bristol
